title: Passive Skills - Levels, Effects, Auto vs Scroll
body:
Syntax: HELP PASSIVE SKILLS | HELP EXTRA ATTACKS | HELP SECOND ATTACK

AUTO means the skill is granted at the listed level (including login catch-up). No teaching scroll is required. SCROLL means READ the specified scroll; leveling alone does not grant it. Passive effects trigger when their conditions are met; an automatic unlock is NOT automatic 100% mastery.

NUMBERED MELEE ATTACKS:
  Second Attack  | ALL classes level 25, AUTO. Rolls an extra normal melee strike each combat round.
  Third Attack   | ALL classes level 75, AUTO. Rolls a third strike only if Second Attack succeeded that round.
  Fourth Attack  | Bukijutsu level 75, SCROLL (VNUM 31742). Rolls a fourth strike only if Third Attack succeeded.
  Fifth Attack   | Bukijutsu level 90, SCROLL (VNUM 31743). Rolls a fifth strike only if Fourth Attack succeeded.
Second and Third Attack require NO SCROLL: they are automatically learned at level 25 and 75, including login catch-up. Their legacy scroll items (31740/31741) are no longer required or consumed. Fourth/Fifth remain scroll-only and Bukijutsu-only. Each attack uses its own proficiency as its proc chance (0% = no bonus attack); the chain ends on the first failed roll. After learning, use PRAC <attack name> with a teacher and train further through combat. Previous mastery is preserved.

OTHER COMBAT PASSIVES:
  Strong Fist Style | All classes, level 1, AUTO. Starting passive; melee damage bonus scales to +10% at 100% mastery.
  Soto Uke          | Taijutsu 19, AUTO. Chance to block an ordinary physical hit; successful blocks cost 10 Stamina.
  Counter Kunai     | Bukijutsu 25, AUTO. Automatically blocks an incoming thrown jutsu when carrying a kunai; normally consumes that kunai.
  Weapon Expert     | Bukijutsu 36, AUTO. Mastery-based proc grants +50% damage to an armed ordinary attack.
  Dual Wield        | Bukijutsu 70, AUTO. Equip an off-hand weapon for a mastery-based extra off-hand strike (5 Stamina on proc).
  Silent Genjutsu   | Genjutsu 75, AUTO. Cast known genjutsu by bare name without hand signs; instant casting. At 100% mastery, hides the technique name from the PvP target.

SAMURAI SABRE PASSIVE TIERS - Bukijutsu, AUTO, no scroll or PRAC:
  Samurai Sabre 2 | Level 85: +5% sword strike damage (10% total).
  Samurai Sabre 3 | Level 140: another +5% (15% total).
  Samurai Sabre 4 | Level 195: another +5% (20% total).
  Samurai Sabre 5 | Level 250: another +5% (25% total).
These tiers take effect ONLY when the level-35 Samurai Sabre skill is toggled on with a sword wielded. They do nothing when it is off.

TRACKING AND CASTING PASSIVES:
  Handsigns        | All classes 20, AUTO. Improves casting speed for jutsu that use hand signs; initial teacher practice is capped at 1%, further mastery grows with use.
  Advanced Tracking| All classes 20, SCROLL. READ its scroll to extend a learned Track jutsu beyond its original area; this is a passive upgrade to Track, not an automatic grant.
  Hidden Tracking  | All classes 50, AUTO. An already-learned Track can follow hidden exits; closed doors still block passage.

SPECIAL SCROLL-ONLY PASSIVE:
  Iron Resolve | Earn the Scroll of Iron Resolve by defeating the Iron Kage at the end of the level-250 Iron Ascension tower, then READ it. Once per fight, an attack taking you to 20% Health or less activates 25% incoming mob damage reduction for 20 seconds. Leveling alone does not teach it.

See HELP PRAC, HELP SAMURAI SABRE, HELP TRACK, and individual skill help pages for more details.
Date: 2026-11-14
